claims: The 2026 UFL season features eight teams.
The 2026 UFL lineup consists of the Birmingham Stallions, DC Defenders, St. Louis Battlehawks, Columbus Aviators, Louisville Kings, Orlando Storm, Dallas Renegades, and Houston Gamblers.
Columbus Aviators, Louisville Kings, and Orlando Storm are new additions to the 2026 UFL lineup.
The Birmingham Stallions' 2026 UFL venue is Protective Stadium.
The Columbus Aviators' 2026 UFL venue is Historic Crew Stadium.
The Dallas Renegades' 2026 UFL venue is Toyota Stadium.
The DC Defenders' 2026 UFL venue is Audi Field.
The Houston Gamblers' 2026 UFL venue is Shell Energy Stadium.
The Louisville Kings' 2026 UFL venue is Lynn Family Stadium.
The Orlando Storm's 2026 UFL venue is Inter & Co. Stadium.
The St. Louis Battlehawks' 2026 UFL venue is The Dome at America's Center.
The 2026 UFL season officially kicks off on March 27.
The 2026 UFL season abandons the league's previous conference structure for a single-table format.
